ordered_step_reconstruction: Put N=n-1. Inverting the j-th positive odd-edge block gives P_j^(-1)=[[ell_j,s_j],[s_j,r_j]] with ell_j>s_j>0 and r_j>s_j>0. The negative-edge incidence rows therefore give H_ii=r_i+ell_(i+1)-W_i and H_i,i+1=-s_(i+1).
Set tau_i=s_(i+1)>0 and subtract incident conductances from each diagonal to define z_i. Entrywise, H=L_tau+diag(z), including the exceptional N=1 case with no path edge.

Adjoin a root vertex and a formal signed root edge z_i at each path vertex. The reduced weighted Laplacian is H. Grouping each spanning tree by the retained path forest leaves interval components, each with exactly one root attachment; summing that attachment gives Z_I=sum_(j in I)z_j. Since the matrix-tree equality is polynomial, signed z and exact cancellation are allowed.

For any positive physical jump vector v_i=(gamma_(2i+1)-gamma_(2i))/W_i, define V=diag(v), q_i=v_i(Hv)_i and e_i=tau_i v_i v_(i+1). Direct diagonal and off-diagonal comparison gives VHV=L_e+diag(q), while det(VHV)=(product_i v_i^2)det(H). Applying the same forest identity yields the interval charges Q_I=sum_(i in I)q_i.
The proof stops at an identity. Neither positivity of P and W nor the alternating event word signs any Z_I or Q_I, so det(H)>0 and reflection do not follow.

Factoring the difference of squares yields E_mu=(sin(mu theta)^2-sin(theta)^2)(1/k_mu-z)(z-k_mu)/(sin(theta)^2 sin(mu theta)^2); the strict phase range makes all prefactors positive, hence k_mu<z<1/k_mu.
